description: The 8 February city-government gathering and 15 February Wuhan park/street gathering are separately dated, physically distinct assemblies in opened reports, and the 8 February report records a stated plan for a later protest. They share the issue and retiree constituency, but the episode/onset rule for repeated campaign gatherings needs reviewer determination. The 15 February report also mentions a second group near Wuhan Union Hospital without enough detail to know whether that was the same simultaneous gathering or a distinct site-event.
required_followup: Review event/episode unit rules against the saved field evidence. Keep the dated gatherings separate pending review; do not infer continuous assembly or merge based only on shared demand. If site-level distinction affects a count, seek a permitted contemporaneous source specifying the Union Hospital group.

description: Open-web first pass used Chinese and English searches for four February date windows, Wuhan/Dalian health-insurance follow-ups, nationwide events, labor/wage issues and local worker leads. Search results were noisy and no systematic city-by-city archive or independently verified national event inventory was available; the search cannot establish that other events did not occur. Several sector leads (including late-February factory/wage and sanitation claims) did not establish an executed public gathering of at least 50 directed at the state.
required_followup: A future bounded pass may target original local reports or organizer/public-authority records for the search-only factory and sanitation leads and other regional/sector coverage; preserve current evidence as provisional and do not convert search snippets or work stoppage claims into events.
